notes: Example recipe to show how the book works. Edit it into your own or delete it. Oxtail wants time: keep the coals low and resist lifting the lid.
steps: Heat the oil in the pot over hot coals and brown the oxtail in batches. Take it out.
Fry the onion and garlic until soft, add the paprika, then return the meat.
Add the wine, stock and bay leaves. Lid on, pull back to low coals and simmer for about 3 hours. Add a little stock if it gets dry.
Pack the carrots, potatoes and butternut on top of the meat. Don't stir.
After 30 minutes add the mushrooms and baby marrows as the top layer.
Cook another 20–30 minutes until the veg is tender.
Stir in the chutney and cornflour paste, season, and serve with rice or potbrood.
title: Oxtail Potjie with Red Wine
